title: Iskra
hint: Connect Iskra with a cable and press to flash
doneHint: Open ImgGen on Iskra — it now paints from the farm
errorHint: Check the cable and try again
unsupportedHint: A browser can't reach the device. Install the app and flash Iskra from there.
installDesc: Works offline, opens like an app
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home Screen.
